Read Vladivideos Transcript Data

Source: R/read_transcripts.R
read_transcripts.Rd

Loads the bundled compiled_transcripts dataset and optionally filters by transcript ID(s).

Usage

read_transcripts(id = NULL)

Arguments

id

Optional numeric vector of transcript IDs to keep. If NULL (the default), all transcripts are returned.

Value

A data frame with columns id, row_id, date, speaker_std, speaker, and speech.

See also

get_transcripts_raw(), get_transcript_id(), get_transcript_speakers()

Examples

# Load all transcripts
all <- read_transcripts()
head(all)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>      id row_id date       speaker_std speaker                      speech       
#>   <dbl>  <int> <date>     <chr>       <chr>                        <chr>        
#> 1     1      1 1998-01-08 background  background                   Departamento…
#> 2     1      2 1998-01-08 montesinos  el señor montesinos torres.- Un gusto en …
#> 3     1      3 1998-01-08 menendez    el señor gonzalo.-           Encantado de…
#> 4     1      4 1998-01-08 montesinos  el señor montesinos torres.- Siéntese.    
#> 5     1      5 1998-01-08 menendez    el señor gonzalo.-           Gracias， muy…
#> 6     1      6 1998-01-08 montesinos  el señor montesinos torres.- Señor Borobi…

# Load only transcript 1
t1 <- read_transcripts(id = 1)

# Load transcripts 1, 8, and 13
subset <- read_transcripts(id = c(1, 8, 13))
